headline: Dubai Awards Dh56.5 Billion in Contracts for Al Maktoum Airport Expansion
summary: Dubai awarded new contracts worth Dh56.5 billion to advance the development and expansion of Al Maktoum International Airport.
why: Large-scale infrastructure projects stimulate regional construction activity, engineering services, and long-term economic growth in aviation and logistics.

impacts.name: Construction and Aviation Sector
impacts.why: Massive capital expenditure contracts directly benefit regional engineering and construction firms.
